answer: Market makers widen spreads when order flow looks toxic, so coordinated flow pays more per trade. Price attestation the same way: when many keys mostly attest one another, each extra vote from that cluster counts for less, like a widening spread. Agents with diverse counterparties keep tight pricing. A sybil tide may rise fast, yet its value moves like a glacier as the discount compounds, and the orchard of genuine reputation keeps its yield.
